_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-12 (V1.1 reconciliation: WF13 redesign companion). Live ID: Bj5b3sUexa8EeQcK. Inbound SMS → classifies cancel/reschedule/confirm_yes/confirm_no intent, finds the relevant appointment, updates status/Reschedule Status/Reschedule Attempts/notes, replies to customer (where applicable), alerts owner, and logs reschedule-confirmation replies to the Communication Log via the CRM Adapter. Cancel/reschedule handling and the SMS opt-out compliance backstop are unchanged from the prior version. New for this pass: 'Normalize Inbound SMS' also classifies standalone YES/NO replies as confirm_yes/confirm_no; 'Find Customer Appointment' matches confirm replies only against appointments with Reschedule Status = 'Pending Customer Confirmation'; 'Build Reply Plan' (CONFIG block at top) handles confirm_yes (sets Reschedule Status = Confirmed, emails owner, logs 'Reschedule Confirmation') and confirm_no (increments Reschedule Attempts; on attempt 1 sets Reschedule Status = 'Customer Requested Different Time' and tells the customer the team will reach out; on attempt >= 2 escalates to 'Manual Follow-Up Required', emails the owner, and tells the customer to call CONFIG.COMPANY_PHONE — no further automated rescheduling). SMS owner alerts continue to follow CONFIG.SMS_ALERTS_ENABLED; email owner alerts follow CONFIG.EMAIL_ALERTS_ENABLED.
name: Reschedule Cancel

parameters.message: Hi, we couldn't find an upcoming appointment under this number. Please call us anytime and we'll be glad to help — Valfin Tech.

parameters.content: This workflow processes incoming SMS messages related to appointment changes, determines whether the customer wants to reschedule, cancel, or is responding YES/NO to a reschedule-confirmation request (WF13), updates the appointment record (Status / Reschedule Status / Reschedule Attempts / Notes) accordingly, replies to the customer where applicable, notifies the business owner, and logs reschedule-confirmation replies to the Communication Log via the CRM Adapter. NO replies escalate to 'Manual Follow-Up Required' after 2 attempts and stop further automated rescheduling.
